name: Shayala Legacy

authors: but you are free to use the portrait for any reason

description:
This one was a complete accident. I was using Klokgen to come up with designs and I came up with a really nice design that suited her well. When I traced the portrait, I tried to encompass her entire upper torso. Upon sharing it in the FE Graphics Repo this "style" was really well liked there, so I decided to use this "Bust" design for all my future character portraits.

This design is nowhere near her final design, I intend on redrawing it from scratch. I am using it temporarily until I redraw it from scratch.
